Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.

kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to express my interest in the Backend Development Intern position at Ylytic. As an MCA student at PES University with practical backend development experience, I am eager to help translate product specifications into a high-performing and scalable product. During my internship as a Full Stack Developer at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready management system using Node.js, Express, and MySQL that went live for real customer bookings. I also implemented role-based access control and secure authentication to separate admin and user workflows. Furthermore, in my Zenvest project, I developed an Express API with JWT-based authentication, Joi request validation, and an internal server-side proxy with in-memory caching to securely integrate third-party market data. My background in building structured backend services and deploying solutions across platforms aligns directly with your goal of scaling a product. I look forward to contributing to Ylytic's engineering objectives and growing into a backend development ownership role. Thank you for considering my application. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
